В игре есть книга со статистикой где расписывается твой прогресс в процентном соотношении, из-за чего появляется большое чувство прогрессии в игре, учитывая что в сюжетном прохождении есть карта с продвижением по уровню, которая выполнена очень интересно. for those who play with a more casual pace, the nightmare difficulty will be really tough (i could complete the first level but felt the frustration in on level two immediately after 5 game overs in less than 15 minutes) if you don't equip your slinger with the proper enhancements. my tip is to [b] pick Tar, Head Start, Tranquility, and Flame Purple [/b]. the game might last longer than your usual runs but it does help to slow down the orbs' speed so you can catch up!

there are also other modes too like survival (which i don't understand why it won't just end once you achieve 5 stars for that level since that's the only objective?), challenge (don't have much say in this except repetitive tracks) and cascade (which i didn't play). there are also no points nor lives to collect so i really don't understand the survival mode... would usually just leave the orbs to be sucked at the end of the tunnel after i reach those 5 stars.

in terms of the story, it isn't as exciting as compared to zuma and tumblebugs which have more of a lore behind the animal you play as the slinger. the story is quite bland for my taste or i might have overstayed my welcome with playing this game 3 times continuously... but even after you unlock all of the enchantments for the slinger, you still have to play the same route in the other difficulties which really bugged me. it would have been better if the sections were closed off and a side storyline could be provided for the hard and nightmare difficulty as to not burn the player out. a plus side here is the narrator's voice which is calming yet ominous as you complete the quest to search for keys to open the portal at the end. music is also good which hypes me up to play and gives me nostalgia while i battle with the orbs :p

Sparkle 2 is an absolute delight of a puzzle game. From the moment you start playing, you'll be hooked by its bright, vibrant graphics and addictive gameplay.

The premise of the game is simple: you control a small, glowing orb as it travels through various levels, collecting other orbs power-ups and avoiding obstacles. The controls are smooth and responsive, making it easy to navigate through the levels and rack up a high score.

But what really sets Sparkle 2 apart is its level design. Each level is uniquely crafted and filled with challenges that keep you on your toes. And with over 100 levels to play through, you'll be kept entertained for hours on end.

In addition to the main campaign, Sparkle 2 also offers a variety of mini-games and challenges that add even more variety to the gameplay. And with a soundtrack that's as upbeat and catchy as the game itself, you'll be humming along as you play.

Overall, Sparkle 2 is a must-play for anyone looking for a fun, challenging puzzle game. Its bright, vibrant graphics and addictive gameplay will keep you coming back for more.

「マーブルポッパー」というジャンルを知ってますか？
マーブルポッパーというのは、いわゆる「カジュアルゲーム」の１ジャンルで、ビー玉みたいなのが連なって動いているところにビー玉を撃ち込んで、同じ色を３つ以上つなげれば消える（消え方によっては連鎖して消える）という、アクションパズルです。有名なところでは「ズーマ」シリーズや「ルクソール」シリーズなどがあります。

もともとカジュアルゲームはBig Fish Gamesとかのカジュアルゲーム専用サイトで盛り上がっていたジャンルなので、Steamではあまり知られていないと思いますが、面白いゲームもたくさんあります。このSparkle 2はその「面白いもの」の１つであることは間違いないので、ぜひ一度試してみることをおすすめします。

[i]Sparkle 2[/i] is a Match 3 game of the arcade type, meaning you shoot balls (instead of swapping tiles on a board) to eliminate groups of three or more balls of the same color.

The game has 4 modes:
- Quest Mode: you travel across a map that leads to various places where you need to look for four keys, having to beat a match 3 level at each of the 92 steps on the map in order to progress.  
- Survival Mode: 32 endless match 3 levels. The longer you can survive, the more stars you're awarded (up to 5 per level).
- Challenge Mode: 24 maps you each need to complete 3 or more times in order to complete the challenge. The difficulty increases gradually.
- Cataclysm Mode: 20 challenging levels to try and beat.

Every couple of levels you clear in the Quest Mode will unlock one of the other game modes, or the 'Hard' and 'Nightmare' difficulty for Quest Mode, or an enchantment. Enchantments are upgrades for your cannon. Your cannon has four slots and by the end of adventure mode, you'll have a choice of four boons for each slot. This means you can actually try and find a 'build' that works for you, which makes the game a personalized experience for each player.

While playing and eliminating groups of same-colored balls, every 3 succesful matches will spawn a power-up. Shooting these power-ups will activate them. The power-ups are varied, some giving you some form of instant major firepower or manipulating the balls' speed or color.

All in all, I had a lot of fun playing [i]Sparkle 2[/i]. Also, with all of its game modes and difficulties, there are a ton of hours of playtime here if you want to get everything done. 

[i]Sparkle 2[/i]'s graphics look fine. Although they're basic, they are colorful and vivid. The music sounds good and it doesn't get annoying, even after playing for a couple of hours. Sound effects are clear and crisp. 

[i]Sparkle 2[/i] has 15 Steam Trading Cards. You'll get 8 while running the game.

Ten of the 14 Steam Achievements will unlock by playing through the adventure mode. The remaining four are a lot more difficult to achieve. They require completing the adventure mode on 'hard' and 'nightmare' difficulty, and completing and acing the 'Survival' and 'Challenge' game modes. Cataclysm Mode was added to the Steam version by means of an update, so that's probably the reason there isn't an achievement connected to that mode.
